_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#6 (advection makes the DG matrix unsymmetric; CG is the wrong solver). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.2, L2 order 1, SIP diffusion alone vs the same form plus b=(20,0) upwind advection, CG and GMRes both from ngsolve.krylovspace with the same CreateSmoother preconditioner and maxiter 500, reference from the umfpack direct solve. Pure diffusion is symmetric to 4.7e-17 and CG converges in 105 iterations to 2.6e-12. With advection the relative asymmetry is 9.8e-2. CORRECTION: the claim offers two alternative signals and only one occurs. CGSolver raises NOTHING -- no exception, no 'not positive definite' message anywhere in the run. It returns normally after consuming all 500 iterations with a relative error of 208 against the direct solve, i.e. a field two orders of magnitude larger than the answer. An agent guarding on an exception, the first branch the claim names, sees a clean solve and ships the wrong field. GMRes on the same matrix and preconditioner converges in 98 iterations to 2.0e-11. Mutation: dropping the advection terms makes CG converge and the fixture fails on advection_breaks_symmetry and cg_fails_silently_not_loudly. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 skips the three advection integrals in build() (the 'if with_advection' block), so the with_advection system is the pure SIP diffusion operator again. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 9 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 drops the relative asymmetry to 4.7e-17 and CG converges in 105 iterations, removing 'advection_breaks_symmetry=True', 'cg_exhausted_its_iteration_cap=True', 'cg_relative_error_exceeds_the_solution=True' and 'cg_fails_silently_not_loudly=True' so the fixture goes red. CAVEAT: 'cg_emitted_positive_definite_message' is evaluated against the caught exception text only, which is empty by construction when nothing is raised; no NGSolve stdout/stderr is scanned, so it does not establish the '_comment' claim that no such message appears anywhere in the run. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
